meta.title: Robin Prause — Engineering leadership
meta.description: Robin Prause builds and runs platforms: payments, search, multi-tenant data, compliance. Employment references and a B.Sc. in Media Computer Science.
meta.og: Platforms, end to end. Payments, search, multi-tenant data, compliance.

hero.claim: I build platforms. And the control that runs them.

hello: You are probably here because you are hiring, or building something. Here is what I do right now:
lede: I have built and run platforms end to end: payments, search, support, shipping, compliance. In-house, with AI agents, and with the audit trail that makes every change traceable.
note: From consulting to full technical ownership. I know both sides: the process, and the code.

work.title: Work
work.lead: If you only read one entry, read the first. The rest shows how I got there.

cto.text: Overall responsibility for strategy, development, and operations of the marketplace and ERP platform. Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Turborepo, Railway, Cloudflare. Commission models and payouts stay configurable, so a new market does not require a code change.

ecommerce.text: Product responsibility for the online shops: roadmap, Shopify, and the connections to warehouse and customer service.

engineer.text: An Angular 19 application in an Nx monorepo, UI from Figma with Tailwind, and interfaces over OpenAPI and RxJS.

projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Reading about it is one thing. Here are three things you can click: the store I run today, Wire's source, and the thesis code.
projects.note: Wire fetches sources, keeps an index, and asks Jev one yes/no question. The repository is public.

wire.where: Python · Qdrant · Jev · one process, many desks
wire.text: Wire reads a set of sources on a schedule, keeps an index, and asks Jev one yes/no question about every new story. Which sources, how often, which question — that is a desk.

events.text: The backend from my thesis: an event manager with staff, lines, business units, feedback and votes. Written in 2023 entirely by prompting chat-based AI models — the experiment the thesis is about. Archived unchanged.

smartport.text: The marketplace I run as CTO: storefront, seller payouts, search, shipping and compliance on one platform. Not a demo — this is the shop that takes orders.

education.title: Education
education.lead: Two lines. The thesis is the interesting one if you work with AI in the browser.
education.text: Bachelor's examination on 19 December 2023. The thesis at Randstad Digital looks at what chat-based AI models can carry in web development, and where they stop.

documents.title: Documents
documents.lead: You do not have to take my word for it. These are the originals, and they open right here.
documents.note: The sheets show the first page of each file, rendered in your browser. Nothing leaves this page.
